summary: Main did not contain a fix. Added a host-side per-communicator stream guard that orders an eager custom all-reduce behind the previous launch when the issuing GPU stream changes. Unit regressions cover stream switching, same-stream reuse, and graph capture; a real gfx950 probe verified event ordering numerically. The original two-rank CUDA/NVLink deadlock could not be reproduced on the assigned single AMD GPU.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=<base archive>/python python -c '<load base custom_all_reduce_utils and require SingleStreamGuard>'
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: the recorded base has no per-communicator stream-ordering guard. Raw output: raw/regression_before.txt
Nine focused tests passed: cross-stream serialization, same-stream fast path, capture boundary, both communicator launch hooks, and adjacent v2 capability behavior. Raw output: raw/focused_tests.txt

On one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, a delayed write on stream 1 followed by a guarded increment on stream 2 produced 2, equal to the CPU reference; the guard created an event. Raw output: raw/gfx950_stream_guard.txt
All applicable formatting, lint, spelling, safety, and registered-test registry checks passed. Raw output: raw/precommit.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) executed the two-stream event-ordering probe; actual result 2 matched CPU reference 2. This was not a custom all-reduce or multi-GPU reproduction.

remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 AMD GPU was available; the reported two-rank A100 CUDA/NVLink deadlock was not reproduced.
CUDA CustomAllReduceV2 kernels were neither compiled nor executed in this ROCm environment.
The host guard cannot observe two CUDA graphs replayed concurrently on different streams. Callers must not concurrently replay graphs that share one custom all-reduce communicator.
No full model, serving workload, green-context partition, or multi-node workload was run or claimed.

The open upstream candidate PR also proposes a CUDA device-side spin deadline; that broader kernel change was not copied because this environment cannot provide the required CUDA compiler/ISA and runtime validation.
